name: LSD
notes: Archetypal hallucinogen. Positive control for every separation test.

name: mescaline
notes: Low potency but unambiguously hallucinogenic in humans.

name: DOI
notes: Reference HTR-positive agonist; standard rodent tool compound.

name: 25CN-NBOH
notes: Native ligand of 6WHA. Also the redocking validation target.

name: lisuride
notes: THE critical negative. Differs from LSD by one amide-to-urea swap. If the pipeline cannot separate REF001 from REF007 the method does not work.

name: 2-bromo-LSD
notes: LSD plus one bromine. Non-hallucinogenic in humans. Second half of the hardest pair in the set.

name: tabernanthalog
notes: NOT an isoquinuclidine - that is ibogaine. TBG is an azepinoindole; the isoquinuclidine was deliberately removed. See DECISIONS.md ADR-004.

name: zalsupindole
notes: Structure IS public, contrary to initial assumption. Resolved via PubChem synonym chain zalsupindole -> AAZ-A-154. Confidence medium pending human confirmation that the INN maps to this exact structure - see TODO in SOURCES.md.

name: IHCH-7086
notes: Partial agonist. Native ligand of 7WC9. Supports the partial-agonism proxy (ADR-007).

name: RS130-180
notes: beta-arrestin-biased. Native ligand of 9AS9; extract SMILES from the PDB chemical component rather than by name lookup. BLOCKED - see SOURCES.md.

name: 6-fluoro-DET
notes: Classic non-hallucinogenic tryptamine 5-HT2A agonist. Useful second tryptamine-class negative.

name: serotonin
notes: Endogenous agonist. Efficacy reference for all Emax normalization. Not a screening negative - used as the Emax denominator.
